articles.title: Breedon Group (LSE:BREE) Stock Still Looks Reasonable On Current Earnings
articles.summary: Breedon Group has delivered a 3 year return of 22.6%, which naturally puts a spotlight on what investors are paying for its earnings today. With the share price recently closing at £3.444, the immediate question is how much of the cement and aggregates producer's earnings power is already reflected in that figure. Over 3 years the stock is up 22.6%. That places greater emphasis on whether the current earnings multiple is being driven by sustainable profit power or by optimism that may or may...
